text:
carla_procure: FYI — got a note from HyperForward on the H100 shipment. They propose splitting the wave: 30 units -> EU pool, 10 -> APAC, holdback 5 units for RMA/refurb. Pricing uplift +2% for the split. ETA window 2025-07-12 to 2025-07-18. They want confirmation by EOD.
ben_sre: Ugh, that holdback screws our EU launch cap plan. Do we have loaner headroom to cover the first 2 weeks?
ashley_ops: We can cover ~8 units from the temp pool in EU for two weeks. APAC has 0 spare.
carla_procure: Thanks. HyperForward is also asking to escrow serial ranges with them while they're staging to avoid cross-alloc. They want written ACK that we accept their holdback terms or they push the whole wave back 10d.
min_sre: If we ACK, we need contract credit for any DOA beyond warranty SLO. Also insist on 48h RMA replacement SLA for critical tags.
kyle_support: Any customs reclass risk with the split? EU customs wanted consolidated invoices last time and that caused a 4-day hold.
carla_procure: I flagged the EU HS code and requested consolidated paperwork per EU broker preference. HyperForward said they'll provide separate AWBs but a single commercial invoice if we sign the holdback.
procure-bot: auto: uploaded PO #RWI-4432, vendor terms draft v2 to /contracts/PO-RWI-4432.pdf
ben_sre: If they insist on escrowed serials, we need the ranges mapped to our allocation sheet. Ask for explicit serial blocks and a parity checksum so we can reconcile on arrival.
carla_procure: asked for serial blocks. they replied with initial ranges (pasted below). I told them we need manifest-level AWB + invoice & photo evidence at departure.
carla_procure: ```
EU batch: H100-00012001 -> H100-00012030
APAC batch: H100-00012031 -> H100-00012040
Holdback (RMA reserve): H100-00012041 -> H100-00012045
```
ashley_ops: Good — please get vendor to sign that those ranges are immutable and to provide pre-shipment photos with IMEI/serial visible. Also request thermal test evidence for the EU batch (last time we saw two DOAs flagged).
min_sre: Also request their proposed RMA routing: do they want returns to their EMEA depot or our EU depot? Routing affects lead time and cost.
carla_procure: They prefer returns -> HyperForward EMEA depot (warehouse in NL) unless we elect depot-to-depot swap. They offered to absorb return freight for DOA within 30 days, but only if we accept the holdback.
kyle_support: Can they give a credit instead of holdback? e.g., 5% credit on holdback units and we release them to us immediately?
carla_procure: Counter-proposed: no holdback if vendor provides 3% uplift credit + on-delivery QA photos + 48h advance AWB. Waiting on reply.
ben_sre: If they won't budge, accept holdback only if their RMA turnaround is <7 days for critical serials and they pre-stage replacements in EU. Otherwise request loaner commitment.
ashley_ops: Decision for launch: we accept their temporary holdback for up to 5 units if vendor also provides a refundable credit and covers expedited return freight. We can frontload 6 units from the temp pool to avoid launch risk.
carla_procure: Noted. I'll confirm acceptance contingent on docs + credit. Also asked vendor for a written SLA with penalties for missed RMA windows.
procure-bot: auto: vendor reply uploaded to PO thread; filename: hyperforward-acceptance-draft-2025-06-22.pdf
carla_procure: Vendor replied — they accepted the 3% credit counter-offer but want a 2-day staging buffer before AWB handoff. They also included an estimated expedite surcharge for cross-split shipments: 
```
Split handling surcharge: $1,800 per split (flat) + $45 per unit split handling
Expedite AWB fee: carrier rates at time of booking
```
min_sre: Put that against our unit economics — $1,800 + (40*$45)= $1,800 + $1,800 = $3,600 split cost, divided across 40 units = $90/unit extra. 3% credit on list price covers about $120/unit so we're fine.
ben_sre: Ok math checks. But we should cap acceptance: only if we get the manifest + pre-departure photos and vendor signs RMA SLA <72h for replacements to EU depot.
carla_procure: Agreed. I'll sign off if they provide: (1) pre-departure photos, (2) immutable serial manifest, (3) AWB + consolidated invoice, (4) 3% credit, (5) RMA SLA <=72h for EU replacements.
kyle_support: One more ask — insist they include the HA tags for units allocated to Dedicated pools (we need those in provisioning).
carla_procure: Adding that to the ask. Sending confirmation now.
ben_sre: thanks. after they confirm, please update the allocation spreadsheet and ping infra-provisioning channel so they can prep images + inventory mapping. :rocket:
carla_procure: will do.
ashley_ops: also tagged support to prepare a temporary scaling plan if APAC misses its window.
carla_procure: final vendor reply came in — they accepted conditions and attached departure manifest + photos and provisional AWBs. They still want our OK to release the single invoice format.
ben_sre: OK to accept consolidated invoice as long as AWBs are per-shipment and serial manifest matches line items.
carla_procure: Great. Signed off and pushed PO update. Closing this thread once infra confirms provisioning mapping.
min_sre: I'll follow up with infra tomorrow to map serials -> GPU pool tags.
carla_procure: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
